title: Combine multiple monthly sales files
prompt: Sketch a safe batch pipeline to discover monthly CSVs, validate schemas and bind compatible rows.
objective: Practice file handling, row binding, automation with explicit acceptance criteria and a reproducible result.

starter.source_code:
files <- list.files("data/monthly", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
parts <- lapply(files, read.csv)
combined <- do.call(rbind, parts)
